title: Function Contract DSL and Diagnostic Protocol for Parameter Validation
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design and implement a compact, forward-compatible DSL for describing function/tool call parameters (the "Contract DSL") along with a diagnostic protocol for deterministic, actionable validation errors. Goal: make runtime parameter validation consistent across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments while minimizing noisy errors for clients and preserving streaming/structured output semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Contract DSL spec document describing syntax, versioning ($contract_version), and supported types (primitive, arrays, objects, enums, named-unions)
Runtime validator library (JS/Go/Python) that can produce standardized diagnostics and can operate in strict and permissive modes
Error diagnostic schema with stable codes (FCT-XXX) and 'suggestions' / 'repair' hints included in validation responses
Backward-compatibility shim that transforms legacy param payloads (legacy key aliases, flat->nested mappings) when enabled
Streaming validation hooks: validators can emit VALIDATION_WARNING frames in streaming responses and an end-of-validation summary frame
Integration tests covering coercion, defaulting, enum mismatch, missing required fields, extra fields, and partial-success for multipart executions
design_notes: Use a compact DSL optimized for authoring inside model prompts and for registry storage: favor concise keywords (e.g., 's' for string, 'i' for integer, 'arr', 'obj') but allow full names for readability
Top-level contract must include a $contract_version integer and an optional $compatibility_policy: 'strict' | 'lenient' | 'shim'
Validation modes: strict -> reject on any mismatch; permissive -> coerce where safe and surface diagnostics; shim -> apply mapping rules then validate
Diagnostics: each issue should include code, severity (error/warn/info), path (dot notation), observed_value (stringified), expected (human-friendly), and optional repair_hint

Diagnostic codes namespace FCT - function contract tooling. Example codes: FCT-001 MISSING_REQUIRED, FCT-002 TYPE_MISMATCH, FCT-003 ENUM_VIOLATION, FCT-004 COERCION_APPLIED, FCT-005 EXTRA_FIELD, FCT-010 MALFORMED_SCHEMA
Streaming: declare a new frame type VALIDATION_WARNING that can appear before/while tokens stream; include a final VALIDATION_SUMMARY frame at call termination for non-streaming and streaming calls
Structured outputs: validators must not break structured-tool outputs; instead they should attach diagnostics alongside the tool response object under a reserved key (e.g., '_validation')
Telemetry: incremental diagnostic counters and histograms per diagnostic code and per API route; include a sampling policy for high-volume routes
implementation_plan: Prototype JS validator using existing JSON Schema runtime for reference, then replace with compact parser to reduce overhead
Implement diagnostic payload format and stable codes in runtime protocol layer
Add ability to toggle validation mode per-route and per-customer via console + API (default: permissive for hosted free tiers, strict for enterprise by default)
Add streaming VALIDATION_WARNING and VALIDATION_SUMMARY frames to runtime framing layer; update client SDKs to parse and surface these
Create backward-compatibility shim module with configurable alias maps and flat->nested mapping rules
Instrument telemetry and create dashboard (Console) for top diagnostics and recent samples
Write integration tests and fuzzing harness that mutates valid payloads and asserts diagnostic coverage
migration_plan: Phase 1 (spec + validators): publish spec, opt-in SDK validator, no enforcement in server; provide guidance for model-authoring and tool authors
Phase 2 (telemetry + shim): enable telemetry and shims for legacy clients; collect high-frequency diagnostics and populate console insights
Phase 3 (soft-enforce): enable permissive enforcement with 'extra_fields' warnings surfaced to callers; notify affected customers and provide repair hints
Phase 4 (strict-enforce): flip to strict for new contract versions and for customers on Dedicated/Private who opt-in to stricter SLOs; provide migration scripts and a rollback path
test_cases: Required field missing -> expect FCT-001 (error) in strict, FCT-001+repair_hint in permissive
Type mismatch (string '123' -> integer) -> expect FCT-002 and FCT-004 if coercion applied
Enum value invalid -> expect FCT-003 with suggestion of nearest enum literal (Levenshtein) when available
Extra unknown fields -> FCT-005 warn in permissive, error in strict
Streaming call where validation fails mid-stream -> emit VALIDATION_WARNING immediately and VALIDATION_SUMMARY at end
Partial success: tool accepts smaller subset of params -> validate accepted subset and surface missing/ignored params via diagnostics
